analysis.title: GS Futures Global Equity CTA - Market Update - November 02, 2026
key_insights: Goldman Sachs Futures Sales Strats published its CTA (trend-following futures funds) market update on 2 Nov 2026. The text extraction contains only exhibit titles and legends, so no positioning levels, forecasts or flow figures can be read from it.

The note includes conditional regional and market forecasts at a 1-month horizon, simulated net length history over 1 year, momentum thresholds for N. America, EMEA and Asia-Pac & EM, and simulated realized flows.

The legend defines net length as a rolling 1-year distribution of CTA positioning per market, with the current value marked against the interquartile range, min/max and theoretical min/max from the desk's models.
The desk states this is not a Global Investment Research report. Charts are backtested or simulated results for illustration only.
risk_factors: The desk notes the simulated and backtested results carry no guarantee of past or future operation and exclude liquidity and transaction costs.
vol_and_positioning: CTA net length by market, conditional forecasts, momentum thresholds and simulated realized flows are presented as charts only. No values appear in the extracted text.
